title: Dimension-free spectral laws and the risk of spectral filters
abstract: arXiv:2611.21254v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spectral properties of the sample covariance are key to modern machine learning with high-dimensional data. Random matrix theory (RMT) supplies powerful tools; however, most classical results assume proportional asymptotics, where $d/n$ tends to a finite limit. In functional data analysis and kernel methods, a fixed infinite-dimensional Hilbert space is often the more natural setting for the observations, beyond the scope of proportional asymptotics. This calls for a dimension-free spectral theory for i.i.d. observations $\boldsymbol{x}_1, \dots, \boldsymbol{x}_n$ in a Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}$ with trace-class population covariance $\Sigma$. Building on the dimension-free ridge regression analysis of Cheng and Montanari (2024), we establish two deterministic equivalents with explicit nonasymptotic error bounds. The first approximates the empirical spectral law $\widehat{\mu}_n$ of the sample Gram matrix by a deterministic law $\mu_n

translated_title: 无维度谱定律与谱滤波器的风险
translated_abstract: 样本协方差的谱性质是高维数据现代机器学习的核心。随机矩阵理论（RMT）为此提供了强大的工具；然而，大多数经典结果都假设比例渐近性，即 $d/n$ 趋于一个有限极限。在函数型数据分析和核方法中，固定的无穷维希尔伯特空间往往是观测数据更自然的设定，这超出了比例渐近性的适用范围。因此，需要为希尔伯特空间 $\mathcal{H}$ 中具有迹类总体协方差 $\Sigma$ 的独立同分布观测 $\boldsymbol{x}_1, \dots, \boldsymbol{x}_n$ 建立与维数无关的谱理论。基于 Cheng 和 Montanari（2024）的与维数无关的岭回归分析，我们建立了两个具有显式非渐近误差界的确定性等价物。第一个用确定性的谱定律 $\mu_n 来近似样本 Gram 矩阵的经验谱定律 $\widehat{\mu}_n$…
tldr: 该论文突破了经典随机矩阵理论中比例渐近性的限制，在无穷维希尔伯特空间设定下建立了与维数无关的谱定律，给出了样本 Gram 矩阵经验谱定律的确定性等价物及显式非渐近误差界，为函数型数据分析和核方法中的谱滤波器风险分析提供了理论工具。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes dimension-free spectral laws for i.i.d. observations in infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, going beyond classical proportional asymptotics by deriving deterministic equivalents with explicit nonasymptotic error bounds for the empirical spectral law of sample Gram matrices, enabling risk analysis of spectral filters in functional data analysis and kernel methods.
